verdict.rationale: Hugging Face's chat-completion docs cover "grammars, constraints, and tools" and describe a strict flag under which the model "will always follow the exact schema defined in the `schema` field". That is first-party schema-constrained output. The evidence is limited to brief snippets, with no detail on how far it extends across providers. Missing for 10: documentation of which providers/models honor schema/grammar constraints, detail on grammar formats beyond JSON schema, independent or hands-on corroboration that responses parse reliably.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enforce structured outputs against a JSON schema (or grammar) so model responses parse reliably

citations.quote: If set to true, the model will always follow the exact schema defined in the `schema` field.
